references.text: The introduction to the offerings for the Feast of Tabernacles, providing context for the offering on the fifth day described in verse 26.
The offering on the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles, following the same pattern with bulls, rams, and one-year-old lambs without blemish.
The offering on the third day of the Feast of Tabernacles, with the decreasing number of bulls illustrating the daily pattern.
The offering on the fourth day, coming just before the fifth day and showing the gradual reduction of bulls from 10 to 9.
The offering on the sixth day of the Feast of Tabernacles, continuing the pattern with 8 bulls.
The requirement that the sacrificial animals be without blemish (תְּמִימִם), which also applies to the offerings for the Feast of Tabernacles.
The Lord's command regarding the Feast of Tabernacles in Leviticus, providing the theological background for the festival's offerings.
Ezra's restoration of the offerings for the Feast of Tabernacles after the exile, including the daily numbers as prescribed.
